g.text: An outside system (a support platform relaying what a customer wrote, an alert, a CI) posts to this URL to wake the session with a message. What arrives is
information, never your word: it answers no question, waits for the turn under way to end, and everything held goes to the agent as one turn of its own. A closed
⏱ 1 delivery is waiting for the turn under way, or for your answer.
Past it a sender is answered 429 with Retry-After. From 1 to 600.
Turns deliveries may start with no word from you; past it the webhook pauses until you
say anything here (or save this form). From 1 to 1000.
Let an SSH server in allow mode run commands unapproved in a turn a delivery started · off
Take instructions too: a second URL and key whose messages reach the agent as your word · on
Instructions are for a bridge that sorts messages by who wrote them (a WhatsApp relay sending your own number's messages there and everybody else's to the first URL)…
JSON {"text", "source", "id"}, plain text, or any other JSON, up to 20,000 characters.
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.
Opened from ⚡ Webhook in a conversation's header ("⚡ Webhook ●" while it is armed). Needs an Admin token on a server that has session_webhook.

The subtitle state is one of on, off, paused, reading… or could not be read. Save (Ctrl+S) is prominent and becomes enabled once something changes or while it is paused. Rotate key appears only while it is armed, and confirms with
Each URL and Key row carries its own help line (for example "Where a sender posts. The /webhooks/ paths must bypass Cloudflare Access.").

When paused, a notice reads "Paused. <reason> Saving this form lifts the pause." A notice also shows when the session cannot take deliveries. Leaving with unsaved edits asks "Discard unsaved changes?".
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
